title: 12 Best Solo Travel Guide to Lisbon
description: Discover the ultimate solo travel guide to Lisbon! Explore top-rated restaurants, vibrant hostels, and unique experiences perfect for individual adventurers in 2026.

places.name: Time Out Market Lisboa (Mercado da Ribeira)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'prego' (steak sandwich) from O Prego da Peixaria, 'croquetes' from Croqueteria, and a glass of vinho verde.

places.name: Home Lisbon Hostel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mamma's Dinner (daily changing menu, often includes fish or meat dishes with rice and vegetables).

places.name: Taberna da Rua das Flores
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Start with the 'peixinhos da horta' (green bean tempura) and ask your server for daily specials; the octopus salad is usually fantastic.

places.name: Pasteis de Belém
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Several 'Pasteis de Nata' (custard tarts), served warm with a sprinkle of cinnamon and powdered sugar, alongside a 'bica' (espresso).

places.name: A Cevicheria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Chef's Tasting Menu' for a comprehensive experience, or the classic 'Ceviche Puro' and a 'Pisco Sour'.

places.name: Fábrica da Nata (Baixa)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A warm 'pastel de nata' straight from the oven and a 'galao' (milky coffee).

places.name: LX Factory
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a craft beer from one of the bars, a burger from 'A Cozinha Velha', or explore the various food stalls and cafes.

places.name: Augusto Lisboa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs' or a stack of 'Pancakes' with fresh fruit and maple syrup, paired with a fresh orange juice.

places.name: O Prego da Peixaria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Prego de Atum' (tuna steak sandwich) or the classic 'Prego de Vaca' (beef steak sandwich), often served with sweet potato fries.

places.name: Ponto Final
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh grilled fish (ask for the catch of the day), 'Açorda de Marisco' (bread stew with seafood), and a bottle of vinho verde.

places.name: Copenhagen Coffee Lab & Bakery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'flat white' or 'cold brew' and a 'kanelbullar' (cinnamon bun) or a sourdough toastie.

places.name: Gelato Davvero
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A scoop of 'Pistachio' and 'Chocolate' or try a seasonal fruit flavor like 'Mango' or 'Raspberry'.
